simple.meaning: חַסְפַּס (chaçpaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a shred or scale.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 16:14. The surrounding contexts include wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַסְפַּס (H2636) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חַסְפַּס (chaçpaç) / H2636 is traced through Exodus 16:14 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.rootNote: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel ;

occurrences.englishText: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
